svg.title: A decision by hand, written down
svg.desc: A row of the review file: identifier mg.compound:desosamine, other_identifier mg.compound:methymycin, decision keep_apart, a reason saying desosamine is the sugar part of methymycin, citation pubmed:9770448, decided on 2026-10-12. The resolver applies it before the rules that join compounds and proteins and writes a ledger row with rule reviewed_by_hand, decision kept_apart, and grounds that quote the reason and the source.

svg.text: keep_apart: the two can never end up in one node, by any rule or any chain of joins. join: they become one node at once.
